title: Transaction-structure accretion and leverage
prompt:
Choose the best actionable cash, debt, stock, earnout, and seller-note structure for Pioneer.

Begin with the July corporate-development investment-committee thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's banker-case warning. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Model incremental after-tax interest, seller-note cost, foregone cash yield, issued shares, combined earnings, EPS accretion, ending cash, and closing leverage for each documented structure. Earnout fair value is consideration but not closing cash funding. Recommend the most accretive structure that passes both cash and leverage guardrails, and report `recommended_consideration_check` as total consideration minus the stated equity purchase price (zero when balanced).

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also include fees, existing debt, amortization, downside earnings and EBITDA, DSCR, and downside leverage in structure feasibility. Base leverage uses closing debt; end-of-Year-1 downside leverage reduces new debt by scheduled Year-1 principal amortization before dividing by Year-1 downside covenant EBITDA.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `recommended_structure`, `pro_forma_eps`, `eps_accretion_dilution`, `closing_leverage`, `ending_cash`, `new_shares_issued`, `cash_and_debt_accretion`, `balanced_accretion`, `low_leverage_accretion`, `feasible_structures`, `recommended_consideration_check`, `hardened_feasible_structures`, `recommended_all_in_transaction_fees`, `recommended_downside_eps`, `recommended_downside_eps_accretion`, `recommended_downside_leverage`, `recommended_downside_debt_service_coverage`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
